name: Client
definition: A bank customer, identified by client_id, who holds one or more roles on bank accounts and is characterised by gender, birth date and district of residence.
scope: Customer demographics and the identity of the person standing behind an account.

name: Bank Account
definition: A bank account, identified by account_id, opened on a date at a branch located in a district and operating under a statement frequency regime.
scope: Account-level analysis of ownership, loans, transactions and branch location.

name: Disposition
definition: The link record, identified by disp_id, that connects one client to one account together with the role the client plays on that account.
scope: Resolving which client is related to which account and in what role.

name: Account Holder
definition: A client who holds a role on an account, either as its owner or as an authorised disponent.
scope: Statements about account holders, holder identification numbers and who holds an account; the specific role must be resolved through the disposition role value.

name: Account Owner
definition: The client who owns an account; exactly one owner disposition exists for every account.
scope: Ownership questions and eligibility conditions expressed through the owner role.

name: Disponent
definition: A client granted authorised access to an account without owning it; optional and additional to the owner.
scope: Secondary authorised users of an account.

name: Payment Card
definition: A payment card, identified by card_id, issued against a disposition and classified by card class.
scope: Card-level questions including card class and card issuance.

name: District
definition: A Czech district, identified by district_id and carrying a district name; the geographic unit at which client residences, account branch locations and district statistics are recorded.
scope: Geographic grouping of clients, accounts and district-level indicators.

name: Region
definition: A higher-level Czech administrative region that groups several districts, recorded as a region name on each district row.
scope: Regional grouping and region-level filtering of districts; the region name is not a district name.

name: Loan Contract
definition: A loan granted on an account, identified by loan_id, with an amount, a duration, a payment and a contract status.
scope: Loan portfolio and contract-status analysis.

name: Account Transaction
definition: A single movement recorded on an account, identified by trans_id and characterised by a direction, an operation, an amount and a date.
scope: Transaction-level analysis including withdrawals, deposits, remittances and card payments.

name: Standing Order
definition: A recurring outbound payment instruction registered on an account, identified by order_id and described by a symbol and a receiving bank.
scope: Recurring payment analysis, kept distinct from single transactions.

name: Client Gender
definition: The recorded gender of a client, expressed as a single-letter code.
scope: Gender-based grouping and filtering of clients.

name: Client Birth Date
definition: The recorded date of birth of a client, from which age and cohort conditions are expressed.
scope: Age, cohort and seniority conditions on clients.

name: Client Age
definition: The number of full years elapsed between a client's birth date and a reference date fixed by the analysis.
scope: Age conditions and age projections on clients; no age column exists in the data, so a reference date must be chosen explicitly.

name: Loan Contract Status
definition: The coded state of a loan contract, distinguishing finished contracts from contracts still running and whether the client is in debt.
scope: Selecting running or finished loan contracts and expressing debt conditions.

name: Running Contract
definition: A loan contract that has not been terminated and is still being serviced, whether or not the client is in debt.
scope: Used whenever contracts are described as still running; a subset of the loan contract status values.

name: Loan Amount
definition: The principal granted for a loan contract.
scope: Loan size aggregation and comparison against a portfolio average.

name: Account Opening Date
definition: The date on which an account was opened.
scope: Time filtering on account cohorts, such as accounts opened from a given year.

name: Account Statement Frequency
definition: The coded statement-issuance regime of an account, describing when account statements are produced.
scope: Distinguishing accounts that issue a statement after each transaction from periodic statement accounts.

name: Transaction Direction
definition: The coded direction of an account movement, indicating whether value enters or leaves the account and through which kind of cash operation.
scope: Interpreting whether a movement is an incoming credit or an outgoing debit.

name: Transaction Operation
definition: The finer-grained coded operation describing the mode of a movement, such as cash withdrawal, cash deposit, remittance, collection or card payment.
scope: Distinguishing operation modes, in particular withdrawals made with a payment card.

name: Credit Card Withdrawal
definition: A withdrawal performed with a payment card, as opposed to a cash withdrawal over the counter.
scope: Card-usage analysis and filtering of card transactions.

name: Card Type
definition: The class of a payment card, ranging from a basic class through higher card levels.
scope: Distinguishing card levels, including the high-level card class.

name: District Population
definition: The number of inhabitants of a district.
scope: District size comparisons and selection of the most populated district.

name: District Average Salary
definition: The average salary level recorded for a district.
scope: District-level economic comparison and salary-based ranking of clients through the district they live in.

name: District Unemployment Rate 1995
definition: The district unemployment rate recorded for the year 1995, expressed as a percentage. The workload also refers to this column with a mistyped later year label.
scope: Baseline year of the district unemployment comparison.

name: District Unemployment Rate 1996
definition: The district unemployment rate recorded for the year 1996, expressed as a percentage. The workload also refers to this column with a mistyped later year label.
scope: Later year of the district unemployment comparison.

name: Unemployment Rate Increment
definition: The relative change of the district unemployment rate between 1995 and 1996, expressed as a percentage of the 1995 rate.
scope: District-level change statements about unemployment between the two recorded years.

name: District Crime Count 1995
definition: The number of crimes committed in a district in 1995.
scope: District-level crime statistics for the year 1995.

name: District Crime Count 1996
definition: The number of crimes committed in a district in 1996.
scope: District-level crime statistics for the year 1996; the sibling of the 1995 count in the same indicator series.

name: Gender Proportion
definition: The share of clients of one gender among a defined client population, expressed as a percentage.
scope: Composition statements such as the percentage of male clients of a branch district.

name: Average Salary Gap
definition: The difference between the highest and the lowest district average salary levels being compared.
scope: Spread statements about district average salary levels.
aliases: difference between lowest and highest average salary
